critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx loadData(): awaits refreshUser() then immediately does a redundant fetch of /api/family/{user?.id}. This works but duplicates the network call. Cleaner would be to have refreshUser() return the fresh user object (or expose it via a ref) so loadData can use it directly without an extra HTTP round-trip.

home.tsx line 59 uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL directly for the fresh-user fetch, but the season and episode fetches on lines 66 and 77 use the same var — consistent, but if this variable becomes undefined the request URLs become '/api/...' relative paths. Consider validating at module load.

Test user famille.test@mopado.fr has been restored to its original state (all 3 episodes completed). rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (iteration 6): In home.tsx, useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => loadData(), [])) had an empty deps array, so loadData captured the initial (stale) user object. After completing an episode the AuthContext.user was refreshed, but the loadData callback still filtered episodes against the old user.completed_episodes snapshot until a full remount (page reload) rebuilt the closure. FIX (iteration 7): loadData now explicitly fetches GET /api/family/{user.id} and uses that fresh response's completed_episodes for filtering, so a stale closure no longer affects the outcome. VERIFIED: episode disappears immediately upon returning to Home tab; 'Tous les épisodes sont terminés !' card renders as expected.
